title: Recovery 1.3 - what J14's common side is wired to (ohms)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: The red lead stays on J14 pin 1. The black lead goes to U15 pin 8 (3.3 V), then JP5 pin 1 (5 V), then U15 pin 4 (GND). Each reading again with the leads swapped.

callouts.label: J14 pin 1, common side
callouts.note: Top pad of J14's left row, by the printed dot and '1'. Pins 1-3 and R577 are one net (beeper, J-098). Red lead here for all three readings.

callouts.label: R577
callouts.note: The resistor just above J14 pin 1; its right end is on the common net (J-098). Where its other end goes, and so what the common side is pulled to, is what this step answers.

callouts.label: U15 pin 8, 3.3 V
callouts.note: VCC (XMC datasheet rev. J); rings to U17 OUT (J-110). Top-left lead, across from pin 1.

callouts.label: U15 pin 4, GND
callouts.note: VSS; rings to JP5 pin 2 (J-080). Bottom-right lead; pin 1 is at the dimple end of the same row.

callouts.label: JP5 pin 1 (square), 5 V in
callouts.note: J8 supply, pins 1-6 (J-077); 5.01 V measured on a working J8 (J-089). Square pad, '1' printed left of it.

callouts.label: JP5 pin 2, GND
callouts.note: Rings to U15 pin 4 (J-080). Round pad above pin 1. Not used in this step; shown so pin 1 is not mistaken.

terminals.label: Meter black lead: U15 pin 8, then JP5 pin 1, then U15 pin 4
